answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation's own Form 8-K filed with the SEC (Items 1.01, 2.03 and 7.01), dated August 17, 2026; the attached press release (Exhibit 99.1) was not supplied.
answer.note: NVIDIA's August 17, 2026 8-K discloses that NVIDIA itself entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy (Lessor) on leases covering about 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site (PORTS Technology Campus, Pike County, Ohio), with an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC as tenant. Under the filing, NVIDIA's payment obligation for the initial commitment is cumulatively capped at $105 billion, is subject to conditions including the Lessor satisfying ready-for-service conditions (expected beginning in 2028), and is triggered only by a tenant Trigger Event (OpenAI insolvency-driven default or failure to pay), with NVIDIA paying the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and recoveries. NVIDIA may separately provide credit support for about an additional 3.8 GW at its sole discretion. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse amounts NVIDIA actually pays. On this source alone, the supported conclusion is that NVIDIA has taken on a capped, contingent credit backstop for third-party AI data-center leases tied to an OpenAI deployment of its DSX AI factory platform; the size of that exposure relative to NVIDIA's financial position is not assessed here, and the guaranty's economic probability of being drawn is not established by the filing.
limitations: The full text of the Agreements is not in the source; the 8-K states only a summary and that the form will be filed with the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026.
The $105 billion cap is stated only for the initial commitment; no dollar cap or guaranteed minimum values are disclosed for the additional approximately 3.8 GW credit support.
Lease economics, rent levels, lease term structure and the guaranteed minimum value per lease are not disclosed in the source.
OpenAI's credit standing and ability to pay under the leases are not assessed in the source, so the likelihood of a Trigger Event cannot be estimated from this record.
The source does not state whether SB Energy's affiliates or the Lessor have other obligations or financing that would affect the guaranty.
The 2028 ready-for-service timing is a forward-looking expectation in the filing, not a confirmed schedule.
No historical NVIDIA records on Portsmouth, SB Energy or OpenAI guaranties were supplied, so no comparison or revision can be drawn.
The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 was not supplied, so its additional statements are unreviewed.
follow_up: Obtain and review the press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the August 17, 2026 8-K for any figures not contained in the 8-K body.
When filed, review the Agreement form exhibit to the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 for the guaranteed minimum value mechanics, cap structure and termination terms.
Check NVIDIA's subsequent 10-Q and 10-K disclosures for recognition of the guaranty as a liability, any contingent-obligation disclosure, and any amount for the additional 3.8 GW credit support.
Track lease commencement dates and any ready-for-service confirmations for the Portsmouth Site against the stated 2028 expectation.
Monitor OpenAI-related public disclosures or reports bearing on its tenant credit and payment capacity for these leases.
